citations.narrative:
A responsible adult was not available to accompany APHIS Officials during the inspection process at 11:30 am on
7/30/2026. The inspector contacted the licensee by calling their cell phone. Failure to provide access to the facility,
animals, and records for inspection is a violation of the AWA and regulations. Continued failure to provide access is
serious and may result in enforcement action.
